hook: Covering the triangular lattice with non-overlapping unit disks is not monotone in the point spacing
hook_turn: is not monotone in the point spacing
summary: The authors determine exactly, as fifteen intervals of spacing, where a triangular lattice cannot be covered by unit disks with disjoint interiors, showing coverability is not monotone. At the edge spacings 2/sqrt(k), coverage is possible exactly when k is an Eisenstein norm. They also give two new hexagonal coverings and bound the smallest coverable spacing between 2/sqrt(55) and 1/sqrt(13). The exact minimum is still unknown.
title: Covering the Triangular Lattice with Non-Overlapping Unit Disks
